rows.title: Create issue: changing the Project wipes the typed summary, description, priority, dates and points (`key={board.id}` remounts the form)
rows.summary: Now: picking another Project in Create issue keeps type, summary, description, priority, points and dates; only status, labels, epic and sprint reset to the new project's defaults.

rows.title: Job Tracker → Clear all jobs: no Undo, the confirm gives no count and doesn't say it's permanent, enabled with 0 jobs
rows.summary: Now: Clear all jobs names the count and says it can be undone; afterwards an 'N jobs cleared' toast's Undo restores the list (restoreJobs) and it syncs back; the item is disabled with no jobs.

rows.title: ATS → "Switch to Classic" changes the template with no Undo toast (Design's switch has one)
rows.summary: Now: ATS Check → Switch to Classic goes through Design's own pick (usePickCard), so the same 'Template: Classic' toast with Undo appears; the tooltip no longer says there is no undo.

rows.title: Cover letter → Apply generated overwrites a written body and blanks the signature, with no confirm or undo
rows.summary: Now: Apply to Cover Letter shows a 'Generated letter applied' toast whose Undo restores every field it wrote; a signature the user typed is no longer blanked (only the old 'Candidate'/'Professional' placeholder is cleared).
rows.product_call: Undo toast rather than confirm; keep the user's signature

rows.title: Create issue / Create project dialogs lose typed input on Escape or a backdrop click
rows.summary: Now: with something typed, Escape or a backdrop click on Create issue / Create project asks 'Discard this issue?' / 'Discard this project?' (Keep editing / Discard); empty forms close at once; Cancel and × close deliberately.

rows.title: Job form: Cancel, ← and browser Back discard the typed input with no warning
rows.summary: Now: a changed job form asks 'Discard your changes?' (Keep editing / Discard) on Cancel and ←; while changed, closing or reloading the tab brings the browser's leave prompt.
rows.remaining: browser Back/in-app links not guarded: plain HashRouter has no useBlocker

rows.title: No sign-in, account or sign-out control in the Job Tracker or Boards (auth reaches only Dashboard and Editor)
rows.summary: Now: the Job Tracker and Boards top bar has the compact AuthBar: Sign in when signed out, the avatar menu with Sign out when signed in.
rows.product_call: auth only; the résumé cloud icon stays hidden, CollectionSyncDot shows jobs/boards sync

rows.title: Board with filters: no "no matches" line with Group by None, and an issue created in a column that doesn't match the filter vanishes silently
rows.summary: Now: with filters and no match, the columns view shows 'No issues match these filters.' with Clear filters; an issue created that the filters hide gets a '<KEY> created — hidden by your filters' toast with Open.

rows.title: STAR Optimizer loses every edit on a backdrop click
rows.summary: Now: once the statement differs from what the modal opened with, a backdrop click is ignored (Cancel and × still close); untouched, a backdrop click still closes it (R3-010).
rows.product_call: ignore backdrop click rather than confirm, matching other modals

rows.title: Share → Unpublish kills the public link in one click with no confirm; publishing again gives a new address
rows.summary: Now: Unpublish opens an inline warning (anyone with the link loses access; publishing again makes a new link) with 'Yes, unpublish' / Cancel; only the confirm takes it down.
rows.product_call: inline two-step confirm like DesignPanel's Reset

rows.title: Dashboard import errors vanish after 4–8 s and cannot be dismissed (the long scanned-PDF advice is gone before it can be read)
rows.summary: Now: a Dashboard import error stays until Dismiss or the next import; the 4 s/8 s timers are gone (80-dashboard-import-read-error updated to the intended behaviour).

rows.title: ATS one-click fixes (standardize headings, job title first, Grids 1) rewrite sections with no feedback or undo
rows.summary: Now: each ATS section fix shows a toast naming what changed with an Undo that restores just the field it wrote on the sections it changed.

rows.title: Auto-Generate on a Blank letter (no résumé content) silently writes generic filler
rows.summary: Now: the generator shows an amber notice above the preview when the record has no experience, skills or title to draw on.

rows.title: Design → a section's ↺ reset wipes a whole group (colours, typography…) with no confirm or undo
rows.summary: Now: a Design section's ↺ reset shows a '<Section> reset' toast whose Undo writes back only the keys the reset changed.

rows.title: 1-Page Fit's tooltip says margins and line heights, but it also lowers the font size (to 9 pt) and says nothing
rows.summary: Now: the 1-Page Fit tooltip says it may reduce the text size (down to 9 pt), and a fit that lowered the base size shows 'Fits on 1 page — text size 11 → 9 pt.'

rows.title: Section ⋯ → Reset style discards every layout option with no confirm or undo (Delete beside it asks)
rows.summary: Now: a section's Reset style shows a 'Section style reset' toast whose Undo puts the previous settings back.

rows.title: Editor → Import opens a new résumé under the same name with no notice; users think they restored the open one
rows.summary: Now: the editor's item reads 'Import as a new résumé (JSON, PDF, Word or text)', and both editor import paths open the new résumé with 'Imported as a new résumé: the one you had open is unchanged, on the dashboard.'

rows.title: Job Board view says "Drop a job here" in every column when a search matches nothing or there are no jobs
rows.summary: Now: an empty job Board shows one EmptyState: 'No jobs match' with Clear filters when filtering, 'No jobs yet' with Add job when there are none; 'Drop a job here' stays for a genuinely empty column.

rows.title: Your work → ✓ Mark done: no toast, no Undo, the row disappears
rows.summary: Now: Your work's ✓ shows '<KEY> marked done' with Undo that moves the issue back to its column and rank.

rows.title: Job tasks and issue checklist items are deleted in one click with no undo
rows.summary: Now: deleting a job task or an issue checklist item shows 'Task deleted' / 'Checklist item deleted' with Undo that puts it back at its index (useRemoveWithUndo), keeping later edits.

rows.title: Start sprint accepts an end date before the start date and a blank name ("   started" toast); Rename column with spaces does nothing silently
rows.summary: Now: Start sprint shows 'Enter a name' / 'End date must be on or after the start date' and stays disabled until valid; the toast uses the trimmed or existing name; Rename column with only spaces shows 'Enter a name' with Save disabled.

rows.title: STAR Optimizer → Use Template replaces the edited statement with no way back
rows.summary: Now: after a template card replaces the statement, 'Template applied: your statement was replaced.' with an Undo link restores the user's own text.

rows.title: Generated letter copy: "With over several years of hands-on experience"
rows.summary: Now: the impact letter reads 'With several years of hands-on experience…'; a scan of all archetypes found no other broken copy.

rows.title: Job description scanner shows nothing at all when the pasted text yields no keywords
rows.summary: Now: pasted text that yields no keywords shows 'No skills or keywords found in this text — paste the full posting (requirements, tech stack).'

rows.title: Spacing presets overwrite tuned spacing with no undo; a stale "Still 3 pages…" 1-Page Fit notice stays after changes
rows.summary: Now: the 1-Page Fit notice clears once the settings it describes change (a preset, a typed margin, Undo, Reset); Balanced/Spacious show a 'Spacing: <label>' toast whose Undo restores the previous look.

rows.title: Ticking "Currently working here" erases the End Date, so unticking loses it
rows.summary: Now: ticking 'Currently working here' keeps the End Date (hidden and disabled), so unticking brings it back; every exporter already prints 'Present' while current, and the public copy now blanks a current entry's End Date. 96-month-picker (R2-171) and 88-present-entries (R2-150) updated to the intended behaviour.

rows.title: Remove photo deletes the upload at once, no confirm or undo
rows.summary: Now: Remove photo shows a 'Photo removed' toast whose Undo puts the same upload back.

rows.title: Local exports (Markdown, ATS text, JSON) that fail say "Check your connection"
rows.summary: Now: only PDF and Word export failures say 'Check your connection'; local exports say 'Try again, or reload the page if it keeps failing.'

rows.title: A non-image file picked as a custom contact icon silently does nothing
rows.summary: Now: a non-image file picked as a contact icon (field Upload or the icon picker) alerts 'That image could not be read. Please upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF file.' — the same message as the photo upload.

rows.title: Save my design accepts a name already used, making identical cards
rows.summary: Now: a Save my design name matching an existing one shows 'You already have a design named Clean — saving replaces it.' and Save overwrites that design by id instead of adding a duplicate.

rows.title: Education with a GPA but no degree/field prints a stray leading " · " (main column and Timeline); Word is right. With no school, PDF and Word split the header differently
rows.summary: Now: the PDF's Education (shared and Timeline) filter-joins degree and GPA, so an entry with no degree prints 'GPA: 3.8' with no leading ' · ', as Word, Markdown and ATS text already did.

rows.title: Executive/Academic: PDF italicises the second field, location and issuer and joins Inline titles with ", "; Word is upright and uses " — "
rows.summary: Now: Word italicises the second field, location and issuer on Executive and Academic, and joins an Inline title with ', ' ('Acme, Engineer'), as their PDF does; other templates unchanged. 04-word-export's Executive 'Lead — Acme' updated to 'Lead, Acme'.

rows.title: Centred sections: Word puts the date on its own line; the PDF prints "Title · date" (tests/pdf/10-section-alignment-word pins the old Word layout)
rows.summary: Now: a centred dated entry in Word prints 'Title · date' on its first line, then the sub and location, as the PDF's CentredLine; certifications and awards keep the date under the name as their PDF does.

rows.title: Projects in Word: technologies and link on the title line, a leading " · " when the name is empty; the PDF puts them on the next line
rows.summary: Now: Word Projects print the name alone on the date line and technologies · link on the next line, with ' · ' only between two present parts, as the PDF does.
rows.remaining: Sidebar PDF project card prints tech and link on two lines (not this row)

rows.title: Awards in Word: " — Issuer" with a leading dash when the title is empty; the PDF stacks title, issuer and date
rows.summary: Now: Word awards stack title, issuer and date on their own lines as the PDF does, never with a leading ' — '; a certificate with no name no longer starts with ' — ' or ' · ' in Word.

rows.title: The PDF letterhead prints the photo; the Word letter never does
rows.summary: Now: the Word letter's letterhead prints the same photo as its PDF (same source rules, same position: above a centred name, else in a column beside it).

rows.title: Timeline: a section heading can be orphaned at a page foot (fixed 5-line keep < first entry head + its keep)
rows.summary: Now: a Timeline section title keeps the space its first entry's head really takes (timelineHeadPresence), so it moves to the next page with that head instead of being left alone.
rows.remaining: wrap case has ~0.4 pt margin; 3-line wraps fall short as on other templates

rows.title: Alignment Center: bullet markers stay at the left margin while the text is centred
rows.summary: Now: a centred or right-aligned list item prints its marker inline with its text ('• Cut costs 20%'), matching Word; left and justify keep the marker column.

rows.title: Letter's stacked job title is Regular where its résumé's is Medium (Banner, Timeline, Compact, designed); reversed on Academic Inline
rows.summary: Now: the letter's job title uses its résumé template's title weight in the same layout (Medium on Banner, Timeline, Compact and designed layouts; Regular stacked on Classic/Minimal/Executive; Academic 400 italic).

rows.title: Broadsheet's heading rule is above the title in the PDF, below in Word; Gridline/Registry/Chronicle/Keystone marks drop to plain in Word
rows.summary: Now: Word section headings follow the PDF's variant: Broadsheet rule on top, Gridline top and bottom, Registry dotted, Chronicle double, Keystone a 3 pt left bar with shading.

rows.title: Languages in Word print "English — Native" and ignore Level (dots/bar)
rows.summary: Now: Word Languages drop the ' — ', put the proficiency at a right tab, and show Dots/Bar levels as accent glyphs (●●●○○ / ▰▰▰▱▱).

rows.title: References in Word join title+company and email+phone ("  \|  "); the PDF uses one line each
rows.summary: Now: Word references print job title, company, email and phone each on its own line like the PDF card, no ', ' or ' | '; links kept.

rows.title: ATS plain text lists LinkedIn before Website and ignores display labels; every other export follows CONTACT_FIELDS order
rows.summary: Now: the ATS text contact line follows contactItems' fields and order (email, phone, location, website, linkedin, github), keeping raw values.

rows.title: Languages: proficiency ends 12 pt short of the right margin, out of line with the dates
rows.summary: Now: a Languages proficiency in the PDF ends at the right margin, in line with the dates (no 12 pt padding; a minimum fieldGap between name and proficiency).

rows.title: Interest chips are spaced twice as far apart as skill tags and grow with Spacing
rows.summary: Now: main-column interest chips are 3 pt apart at Normal and scale with Spacing like the Sidebar's, matching skill tags at Normal.

rows.title: Sidebar column Skills "Bars": double gap between groups and 4 pt extra under the section
rows.summary: Now: Sidebar side-column Bars are 4 pt apart within a group, groups are separated by the item gap alone, and the section ends at its last bar.

rows.title: A certification with no name prints a leading " — Issuer" (or "· ID: …")
rows.summary: Now: a PDF certification prints separators only between present fields ('Amazon Web Services · ID: ABC123'; 'ID: ABC123' with neither name nor issuer).

rows.title: Sidebar main-column card dot sits at a fixed 4 pt, so it rides high at larger entry sizes
rows.summary: Now: the Sidebar card's dot is centred on the title's capitals at every entry size (capMiddle shared with the Timeline, moved to pdfMeasure.js).

issues: R4-DOUT-01: the no-school case still split the header differently from Word — fixed (3e3746f).
R4-DOUT-07: the Timeline title's keep skipped SectionTitleOf's 3-line floor — fixed (1b1aacf).
R4-DOUT-04 × R4-DOUT-03: the centred project line and its test had to be combined — resolved in the Word merge.
R4-DOUT-11: Word's proficiency tab stopped 12 pt short after R4-DOUT-14 made the PDF flush — fixed (3e1e87d).
R4-DOUT-03: a centred Timeline entry must keep its date on its own line in Word, as its PDF does — fixed (3457f1e).
R4-DUX-14, R4-DUX-16, R4-DUX-27: an Undo could write into another résumé opened meanwhile — guarded (80160eb, 7770533, b4d2d8c).
R4-DUX-30: replacing a same-name design saved on another template silently moved other résumés off it — such a name is now refused (be7eed9).
R4-DUX-19: Undo of Mark done left a recurring issue's next occurrence behind — removed when untouched (b426437).
R4-DUX-06: browser Back still lost the job form — the draft is kept in sessionStorage and restored (f4fa699).
R4-DUX-17: a cover letter's file imported in the editor said 'new résumé' — says 'new cover letter' (45582c2).
CI: a notice dismissed by an unmounting panel set a timer after the ToastProvider was gone ('window is not defined') — Toast.jsx ignores dismissals after unmount (e66a48b).
fixedByReviewer: All the above were fixed by the row's own agent or the coordinator after a second-agent review; seven reviewers covered every row.

notes: 48 findings (30 R4-DUX flow/UX, 18 R4-DOUT printed output) found by five finder agents, each fixed by its own agent in a worktree, reviewed by a second agent, merged into this branch. Product calls are in each row's product_call. Not done (noted, out of scope): accessibility items seen (TodoItem delete button has no accessible name); DUX-22's Undo disappears on the first edit after a template (kept to one step); the Sidebar PDF project card prints tech and link on two lines while other templates join them; Word's reference e-mail has no 2 pt top gap like the PDF card; ExportDropdown's Word hint about designed layouts' rules is now partly stale (pinned by 83-templates-ui-leftovers). The tests/pdf/parity section.itemGap check was updated for R4-DOUT-15's intended chip gap. docs/tracking was not edited.
